findings.session_summary: Initial session establishing the main barrier as visual access to the board (copying wrong numbers) and uncertainty about seat changes. The student requested practical steps rather than judgmental support.
findings.primary_concern: Visual access to the board and uncertainty regarding seat arrangements.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Note one lesson where the obstacle occurs.
Request to check school policy/contacts regarding seat changes or clearer copies.

next_steps: Student to attempt noting one lesson with the obstacle.
Mentor/Student to identify relevant school contact for seat/copy requests.
uncertainties: Exact dates of incidents are uncertain.
Whether external services (seat change, clearer copies) are available or approved is unknown.
Completion of the between-session task is pending verification.
findings.conclusion: The session established the barrier and a small preparatory task. No external support was delivered. The main barrier remains unresolved, and the agreed action to note the obstacle is pending completion.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up session where the student reported starting but not finishing the between-session task due to schedule constraints. The main concern persisted.
findings.primary_concern: Visual access and uncertainty remain; the agreed task was partially attempted but incomplete.

tracked_details.detail: Attempt to note one lesson with the obstacle.
Agreed between-session task: Ask whether a clearer copy can be provided in one class.

next_steps: Student to attempt asking for a clearer copy in one class.
uncertainties: Whether the request for a clearer copy will be approved or feasible remains unknown.
Completion of the new task is pending verification.
findings.conclusion: The student attempted the previous task but did not complete it fully. A new task regarding clearer copies was proposed. No external support was delivered. The main barrier persists, and the status of the requested school adjustment remains uncertain.

findings.session_summary: Third follow-up session where the student reported that the difficulty is still present on some days. The previous task regarding clearer copies was not finished.
findings.primary_concern: Visual access and uncertainty remain; the main barrier has not disappeared.

tracked_details.detail: Attempt to ask for a clearer copy in one class.
Agreed between-session task: Ask relevant teacher what adjustments are feasible.

next_steps: Student to ask the relevant teacher what adjustments are feasible.
